title: Wave Stitch Blanket
description: A repeating blanket pattern that creates gentle peaks and valleys across each row.
expectationText: A longer repeat project where the key skill is keeping increases and decreases balanced so the waves stay even and recognizable.

steps.title: Chain the foundation
steps.instruction: Make a foundation chain in the multiple required for the wave repeat plus turning stitches.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Work the setup row and mark one full repeat so you can check your rhythm early.

steps.title: Row 2
steps.instruction: Increase at the peaks and decrease at the valleys according to the wave pattern.

steps.title: Repeat the wave
steps.instruction: Continue the wave rows until the blanket reaches your preferred length.

steps.title: Finish the final edge
steps.instruction: Work a simple border or final row to steady the top edge before finishing.
